title: DSG PLayIT v2.1.7
changelog:
- Video cards now feature a dedicated chip badge for file size
- Date & time moved to separate line with improved visibility & contrast
- Enlarged video thumbnails for easier browsing
- Added top-right on-screen popup HUD indicator when changing video fit / aspect ratio
- Aspect ratio preference persistence across sessions
- Streamlined player controls with widened button spacing
- Redesigned wide 2-column Video Information dialog fitting all specs without scrolling
- Fixed progress bar tapping & dragging: seamless responsive scrubbing, larger touch target, and gesture isolation
